(rule!
 ;; Rotate every horizontal three-cell orange gate into a vertical magenta
 ;; barrier, making cyan elbows on either side. On each resulting simple cyan
 ;; track, gather its original green endpoint tokens at the lower endpoint,
 ;; packed along the track without loss. Flat tracks keep their token positions.
 ;; Thus the new gate-derived topology, not the old horizontal rails, controls
 ;; both the destination and the number of tokens that settle there.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define prefer-lower? #t)
   (define initial (recolor g 3 8))
   (define gates
    (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) 7) (= (obj-size o) 3)
                            (= (obj-h o) 1) (= (obj-w o) 3)
                            (> (obj-r1 o) 0) (< (obj-r1 o) (- h 1))))
            (objects g 0)))
   (define rotated
    (for/fold ((out initial)) ((o gates))
     (let* ((r (obj-r1 o)) (c (+ (obj-c1 o) 1))
            (sides (set-cell (set-cell out r (- c 1) 8) r (+ c 1) 8)))
      (for/fold ((z sides)) ((rr (range (- r 1) (+ r 2))))
       (set-cell z rr c 6)))))
   (define routing-grid rotated)
   (define cyan (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 8)) (objects routing-grid 0)))
   (define (neighbors p cells)
    (filter (lambda (q) (member q cells))
     (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))) cardinal-deltas)))
   (define (walk p prev cells left)
    (if (<= left 0) '()
     (let ((next (filter (lambda (q) (not (equal? q prev))) (neighbors p cells))))
      (cons p (if (null? next) '() (walk (first next) p cells (- left 1)))))))
   (for/fold ((out rotated)) ((o cyan))
    (let* ((cells (obj-cells o))
           (tokens (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 3)) cells))
           (ends (sort (filter (lambda (p) (<= (length (neighbors p cells)) 1)) cells) cell<))
           (destinations
            (if (or (null? tokens) (not (= (length ends) 2))
                    (= (first (first ends)) (first (second ends))))
             tokens
             (take (walk (if prefer-lower? (second ends) (first ends)) '() cells (length cells))
                   (length tokens)))))
     (for/fold ((z out)) ((p destinations))
      (set-cell z (first p) (second p) 3)))))))

(rule!
 ;; Install each orange 777 bridge as 868, with magenta on the strip cells
 ;; immediately above and below its center. Cyan four-neighbor paths result.
 ;; Count each path's original green tokens and pack them inward from its lower
 ;; endpoint. Equal-height endpoints keep their original token locations.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define (install base)
    (for*/fold ((out base)) ((r (range 1 (- h 1))) (c (range 1 (- w 1))))
     (if (and (= (at g r (- c 1)) 7) (= (at g r c) 7) (= (at g r (+ c 1)) 7))
      (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell out r (- c 1) 8) r c 6) r (+ c 1) 8) (- r 1) c 6) (+ r 1) c 6)
      out)))
   (define (adj p cells)
    (filter (lambda (q) (member q cells))
     (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))) cardinal-deltas)))
   (define (pack network)
    (for/fold ((out network)) ((o (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 8)) (objects network 0))))
     (let* ((cells (obj-cells o))
            (tokens (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 3)) cells))
            (ends (filter (lambda (p) (<= (length (adj p cells)) 1)) cells))
            (level (if (null? ends) 0 (apply max (map first ends))))
            (chosen (filter (lambda (p) (= (first p) level)) ends)))
      (if (or (null? tokens) (not (= (length chosen) 1)))
       (recolor-cells out tokens 3)
       (let walk ((a out) (p (first chosen)) (previous '()) (remaining (length tokens)))
        (if (= remaining 0) a
         (let* ((painted (set-cell a (first p) (second p) 3))
                (next (filter (lambda (q) (not (equal? q previous))) (adj p cells))))
          (if (null? next) painted (walk painted (first next) p (- remaining 1))))))))))
   (pack (install (recolor g 3 8))))))

(rule!
 ;; Open each horizontal orange triple into two cyan side passages separated
 ;; by a vertical three-cell magenta pole. Treat original green markers as
 ;; traversable cyan while discovering the resulting four-connected paths.
 ;; Within each path, collect all markers at its lower endpoint, packed along
 ;; the path. Equal-height endpoints retain their initial markers. Empty
 ;; closed loops stay empty. The rule never relies on fixed stripe coordinates.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define gates (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 7)) (objects g 0)))
     (define cleared (recolor g 3 8))
     (define opened
       (for/fold ((out cleared)) ((o gates))
         (let ((r (obj-r1 o)) (c (+ (obj-c1 o) 1)))
           (recolor-cells (recolor-cells out (obj-cells o) 8)
             (list (list (- r 1) c) (list r c) (list (+ r 1) c)) 6))))
     (define route-grid opened)
     (define paths (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 8)) (objects route-grid 0)))
     (define (neighbors cells p)
       (filter (lambda (q) (member q cells))
         (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))) cardinal-deltas)))
     (define (walk cells current previous seen)
       (let ((next (filter (lambda (p) (and (not (equal? p previous)) (not (member p seen)))) (neighbors cells current))))
         (if (null? next) (list current)
           (cons current (walk cells (first next) current (cons current seen))))))
     (for/fold ((out opened)) ((o paths))
       (let* ((cells (obj-cells o))
              (markers (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 3)) cells))
              (ends (filter (lambda (p) (<= (length (neighbors cells p)) 1)) cells)))
         (if (null? markers) out
           (let ((dest
             (if (or (null? ends) (= (apply min (map first ends)) (apply max (map first ends))))
                 markers
                 (take (walk cells (pick-max ends first) #f '()) (length markers)))))
             (recolor-cells out dest 3))))))))
